name: Cardiac Arrest adds a leeching Shadow DoT to Valanar's Vengeance (#3658)
contract: Cardiac Arrest 806944: "Your Valanar's Vengeance now deals an additional 50% of its initial damage dealt over $806946d, healing you for 50% of the damage dealt." 806944 is one SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AURA with aura 354 (no AuraEffectHandler entry, no HandleProc case), amount 13, TriggerSpell 806946 and ProcFlags 0, and it has no spell_proc row, so the talent does nothing. 806946 is aura 53 SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_LEECH, Amplitude 500, DurationIndex 39 (2 s, 4 ticks), EffectMultipleValue 0.5 (the 50% heal), BasePoints 0 - the per-tick amount has to be supplied by the caller. Valanar's Vengeance 572795 (SpellFamilyFlags0 0x40000) is the probe, following bloodmage-blood-moon.json: 6 s cast, POWER_HEALTH cost, so fixture health is 4000 and landing windows are 9000 ms. DISCRIMINATING: after the talent, the target carries 806946 from the caster and 806946 deals damage ticks; before it, neither happens. The tooltip's 50% total is the expectation (user decision): the record's amount 13 would be 52% over four ticks (coatavern shows 5 and a 10 s duration), so each of the four ticks carries 12.5% of the Valanar's Vengeance hit and the ticks together deal 50% of it.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
SETUP: the probe's health cost fits inside the 4000 fixture health
Control: without the talent no Cardiac Arrest DoT follows
Let the first cast's global cooldown expire
DISCRIMINATING: the hit applies Cardiac Arrest 806946 to the target
DISCRIMINATING: Cardiac Arrest ticks damage on the target
Four ticks of 12.5% deal 50% of the Valanar's Vengeance hit in total
